title: When the Contact Wakes
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Ivo Nakamura, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
